versions.changelog: Format optimization - unified section separators, consistent list styles
Improve Usage Scenarios readability - plain text format
Improve template readability - bold headers instead of code blocks for better contrast
Full English translation - all Chinese removed

Initial release providing expert strategic consulting and business analysis using classic management frameworks.

- Offers data-driven strategic recommendations based on McKinsey, Porter, and Drucker methodologies
- Supports industry research, SWOT, Porter's Five Forces, business model canvas, competitor analysis, and investment advisory
- Includes ready-to-use output templates for reports, SWOT analysis, competitor analysis, and business models
- Emphasizes professional standards: data-driven insights, framework-driven logic, client orientation, and ethical consulting practices
- Example queries guide users for strategic analysis, market entry, and competitor comparisons
